The service must have two or three CoordinationService dependencies.

What The Standard says

“Two-Three” — The Standard limits orchestration-like services to two or three service dependencies to keep advanced flows balanced. read it here.
“Variants Levels” — The variants table defines a Management service as consuming Coordination services. Together these passages require two or three coordination dependencies. read it here.

Why it matters

Management services combine a small number of coordination capabilities at the highest business layer. Limiting dependencies to two or three keeps the service comprehensible and prevents management from becoming an unrestricted application-wide hub.

Bad code example

// Violates STXMG001: The service must have two or three CoordinationService dependencies.
class StudentManagementService(IStudentProcessingService students) : IStudentManagementService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXMG001
class StudentManagementService(
    IStudentCoordinationService students,
    ISchoolCoordinationService schools) : IStudentManagementService { }
